instagram.caption: Dive into the flow 🌊✨! 'Currents of Silt' brings Dhaka’s streets and Bengal’s rivers together in a vibrant animated short. Every droplet remembers who we are. 🌟

linkedin.caption: We are thrilled to unveil 'Currents of Silt', a groundbreaking animated short from our Dhaka studio. By weaving kinetic urban energy with the timeless rhythms of Bengal’s waterways, the film positions the river as a living protagonist that holds our collective memories. This project invites festival audiences to explore cultural identity through innovative visual storytelling.

x.caption: From city streets to silted tides, we flow. Experience 'Currents of Silt' – an animated short where the river breathes and remembers. #CurrentsOfSilt

facebook.caption: Hey friends! 🌟 Our new short film 'Currents of Silt' just dropped, and it’s a love‑letter to the rivers that shape our lives. Join us on a vivid journey from Dhaka’s bustling streets to the mystical tides of Bengal. Let’s rediscover our roots together!
